# Aphrody Bun

Bun is a JavaScript and TypeScript runtime, bundler, test runner and package manager built on JavaScriptCore. This repository contains the Aphrody fork of [Bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun).

Source version: **1.4.4**. Immutable release source: [c73c54fc20222be4f873f90106c49eebad3c7d08](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/bun-os/tree/c73c54fc20222be4f873f90106c49eebad3c7d08). A source version does not establish availability of a published executable.

## Install and published releases

Download qualified executables from [the runtime releases](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/bun/releases). The [runtime site](https://bun.aphrody.com) provides documentation and installation scripts.

On Windows, use the [PowerShell installer](https://github.com/aphrody-labs/bun-os/tree/c73c54fc20222be4f873f90106c49eebad3c7d08/scripts/aphrody/install.ps1). Its `-BinDir` option or `APHRODY_BUN_BIN_DIR` selects the executable directory; installing into System32 requires administrator rights. User state and caches remain under `BUN_INSTALL`. Windows APIs are exported by `bun:windows`, including `win32`.

## Release surfaces

Run `bun run release:surfaces --out <absolute-directory>` from a committed checkout. README, GitHub metadata, agent plugin bundles and static site share the same immutable Git source. `manifest.json` records every generated artifact's SHA-256. Use `--apply` to update the tracked README and GitHub metadata. Network release inventory is captured separately from source facts; `--offline` generates without published-release claims.
